Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, where Driver 1's vehicle was struck from behind by
Driver 2's vehicle at low speed. Driver 1 was the operator and was litsed as the named insured on the policy.
Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time of the impact. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1
slowed in traffic, and Driver 1 gave the same account. Two witnesses at the scene described the impact in terms
consistent with both drivers' statements. Officers photographed the vehicles, and the damage observed is largely
consistent with a low-speed impact of the kind described. Driver 1 reported no prior damage to the vehicle, and none
was observed or noted by officers. Passenger reported neck pain and was assessed at the scene. Offciers noted that
the force of the impact appeared minor, which seemed at odds with the seevrity of the symptoms Passenger
described. Passenger was transported for further evaluation.
